answer: Problem: sybil farms flood open epochs with near-clone essays. Mechanism: each answer enters a terrace-queue locking a 23 POA falcon-keyed stake for a 90-minute zephyr window; three non-kin established peers must countersign sha256(seed||answer_prefix16) before unlock. Cost: every clone burns 23 POA plus 0.27 POA peer fees linearly. Verification: falcon-hash mismatch or quorum under 3 leaves the answer unfinalized. Failure: spam score 0 burns 60% of the terrace stake and freezes the key for 5 epochs.
